scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can two-pass correlation-aware matching recover the strict reliability lost by the 71-active-qubit distance-6 memory without weakening its noise, horizon, confidence, or physical-cost contract?

candidate.selection_rule: after the publicly frozen independent-MWPM route failed, change exactly the decoder route to PyMatching two-pass correlated matching because the same frozen DEM contains decomposable hyperedge mechanisms; do not sample or decode any stochastic candidate shot before this new public freeze

decoder.only_change_from_rejected_route: correlation-aware construction and decoding are enabled

post_freeze_acceptance_contract.correctness_gate: both X and Z upper bounds must be <=0.01 under the exact frozen circuit, noise, horizon, and correlated-decoder conditions
post_freeze_acceptance_contract.decoder_timing_policy: report same-host batch timing and the ratio to the frozen independent-MWPM run; this diagnostic cannot satisfy a hardware decoder deadline
post_freeze_acceptance_contract.b2_credit_policy: a strict pass may establish the physical-memory candidate gate, but full B2 credit remains closed until decoder timing, mismatch robustness, and implementation constraints are accepted
post_freeze_acceptance_contract.p023_b7_policy: #023 and B7 remain closed without million-round direct evidence, drift/correlation stress, a declared decoder deadline, calibrated layout, and architecture gates
post_freeze_acceptance_contract.challenge_binding: after this packet is committed and publicly discussed, derive each seed from a newly revealed salt bound to the public freeze commit and coordinate-canonical circuit bytes

forbidden_pre_freeze_operations: decoding any sampled syndrome under the correlated route
observing a logical-failure count or rate
deriving the acceptance salt or seed
